// Built outside the repository with a path dependency on crosstalk at the
// pinned baseline (7f8a2fb) and its Cargo.lock:
//   crosstalk-spec = { path = "<crosstalk>/spec" }
//   crosstalk-eval = { path = "<crosstalk>/crates/eval" }
//   serde_json = "=1.0.151"
// `cargo run --release > crosstalk-7f8a2fb-corpus-vectors.json`.
//! Reference vectors from crosstalk at the pinned commit, for the bench's
//! corpus tests: the virtual clock (Pace::at, compose, ordinal) and the
//! synthetic credential digest and vendor of corpus agents.
use std::time::Duration;

use crosstalk_eval::corpus::client::{synthetic_client, vendor_of};
use crosstalk_eval::corpus::clock::{EPOCH_MICROS, MIN_STEP, Pace, compose, ordinal};
use crosstalk_eval::keys::{AgentKey, DatasetId, WorldKey};
use serde_json::{Value, json};

fn time(result: Result<crosstalk_spec::support::Timestamp, impl std::fmt::Debug>) -> Value {
    match result {
        Ok(at) => json!(at.as_micros()),
        Err(error) => json!({"error": format!("{error:?}")}),
    }
}

fn main() {
    let paces: [(u64, u64, u64); 9] = [
        (1_000, 5_000, 0),
        (1_000, 5_000, 1),
        (1_000, 5_000, 9),
        (1_000, 5_000, u64::MAX),
        (2_000, 2_400, 1),
        (1_000, 1_000, 3),
        (1_000, 60_000, 42),
        (1_000, 1_001, 7),
        (999, 5_000, 0),
    ];
    let mut majors: Vec<u64> = (0..=40).collect();
    majors.extend([1_000, 12_345, 1 << 20, 1 << 40, u64::MAX / 3_000_000, u64::MAX]);
    let inner: [(u64, u64); 6] = [(0, 0), (1, 0), (0, 1), (999, 999), (500, 7), (1_000, 0)];
    let pace_vectors: Vec<Value> = paces
        .iter()
        .map(|&(min, max, seed)| {
            match Pace::new(Duration::from_millis(min), Duration::from_millis(max), seed) {
                Err(error) => json!({"min_ms": min, "max_ms": max, "seed": seed, "error": format!("{error:?}")}),
                Ok(pace) => {
                    let at: Vec<Value> = majors
                        .iter()
                        .flat_map(|&major| inner.iter().map(move |&(minor, sub)| (major, minor, sub)))
                        .map(|(major, minor, sub)| {
                            json!({"major": major, "minor": minor, "sub": sub, "at": time(pace.at(major, minor, sub))})
                        })
                        .collect();
                    json!({
                        "min_ms": min, "max_ms": max, "seed": seed,
                        "min_us": pace.min().as_micros() as u64,
                        "max_us": pace.max().as_micros() as u64,
                        "at": at,
                    })
                }
            }
        })
        .collect();
    let composed: Vec<Value> = (0..30u64)
        .map(|major| (major, major % 7 * 100, major * 13 % 1_000))
        .chain([(0, 1_000, 0), (0, 0, 1_000), (u64::MAX, 0, 0)])
        .map(|(major, minor, sub)| json!({"major": major, "minor": minor, "sub": sub, "at": time(compose(major, minor, sub))}))
        .collect();
    let ordinals: Vec<Value> = (0..10u64)
        .chain([1_000, 1_000_000, u64::MAX / 1_000, u64::MAX / 1_000 + 1, u64::MAX])
        .map(|n| json!({"ordinal": n, "at": time(ordinal(n))}))
        .collect();
    let agents = [
        ("salt", "trace-0001", "alice"),
        ("salt", "trace-0001", "bob"),
        ("salt", "trace-0002", "alice"),
        ("ai-village", "2026-07-13", "Claude Opus 4"),
        ("demo-swarm/headline", "run", "agent-3"),
        ("wiki", "w ü", "\u{1F600}"),
        ("", "", ""),
    ];
    let credentials: Vec<Value> = agents
        .iter()
        .map(|&(dataset, world, name)| {
            let key = AgentKey::new(WorldKey::new(world), name);
            let client = synthetic_client(&DatasetId::new(dataset), &key, "m");
            let digest = client
                .credential
                .map(|c| c.hash.digest().to_hex())
                .unwrap_or_default();
            json!({"dataset": dataset, "world": world, "agent": name, "credential_digest": digest})
        })
        .collect();
    let models = [
        "bedrock/converse/global.anthropic.claude-opus-4-6-v1",
        "claude-3-5-sonnet",
        "gemini/gemini-3.7-flash",
        "google/gemma-3",
        "openai/gpt-5.6-luna",
        "gpt-4o",
        "deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash",
        "Qwen/Qwen3-32B",
        "script",
        "",
    ];
    let vendors: Vec<Value> = models
        .iter()
        .map(|model| json!({"model": model, "vendor": format!("{:?}", vendor_of(model))}))
        .collect();
    let out = json!({
        "crosstalk": "7f8a2fb",
        "epoch_micros": EPOCH_MICROS,
        "min_step_us": MIN_STEP.as_micros() as u64,
        "paces": pace_vectors,
        "compose": composed,
        "ordinal": ordinals,
        "credentials": credentials,
        "vendors": vendors,
    });
    println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&out).unwrap_or_default());
}
